name.full: Ops Copilot - IT & HR helpdesk agent

description.short: Ask about policies, raise IT tickets, check your leave.
description.full: Ops Copilot is a multi-agent assistant built on Microsoft Foundry. It answers company policy questions with citations, opens and tracks IT tickets (with your approval), and answers personal HR questions using your own Microsoft 365 data. AI-generated content may be incorrect.
